root_cause.text: The reserved trap area size (AMDGPU_VA_RESERVED_TRAP_SIZE) was hardcoded to 8KB, but the actual allocation size (KFD_CWSR_TBA_TMA_SIZE) was defined as 2 * PAGE_SIZE, which on 64KB page systems becomes 128KB, causing the allocation to exceed the reserved virtual address space and triggering a kernel crash.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "on 64K page-size systems, KFD_CWSR_TBA_TMA_SIZE becomes 128KB, while the reserved trap area remains 8KB. This mismatch causes the kernel to crash." The patch fixes this by changing the reserved size to 64KB and redefining KFD_CWSR_TBA_TMA_SIZE in terms of AMDGPU_GPU_PAGE_SIZE (which is always 4KB) to ensure allocation size never exceeds the reserved area.
